segments.name: Medical devices
segments.description: Develops and sells the RNS System, a brain-responsive neuromodulation device that treats drug-resistant focal epilepsy in adults.
segments.evidence: Our novel and differentiated RNS System is the first and only commercially available, brain-responsive neuromodulation system that delivers personalized, real-time treatment at the seizure source.

revenueModel.text: The company sells its RNS System and replacement neuromodulation devices to hospitals and clinicians, primarily in the United States, with reimbursement under established physician and hospital codes.
revenueModel.evidence: The sale of replacement neuromodulation devices provides a recurring revenue stream that is additive to the market opportunity for initial implants.
